tagline: Translate cURL commands into the shell-friendly HTTPie CLI syntax
pageDescription: Free cURL to HTTPie converter transforms cURL commands into the more readable HTTPie http / https CLI syntax. Emits short-hand header (key:value), query (key==value), JSON body (key=value for strings, key:=value for raw JSON), --auth for Basic auth, --timeout and --verify=no for SSL skip. Perfect one-liners for quick API testing, documentation snippets, or Slack shares. Browser-based conversion — nothing leaves your device.

SSL error: add --verify=no only for local dev or trusted internal endpoints
Quoting issues: wrap values with special chars in single quotes
Missing headers: verify -H flags are converted to 'Header:Value' syntax
